name: hermex-fixture-all-rule-types
description: A repo engineered so every one of the nine rule types fires at once, which no other fixture does: `license` is missing (require_package_fields), `publishConfig.registry` is present (forbid_package_fields), engines.node is below the required range (engine_version), `build` and `test` scripts are absent (require_scripts), moment is declared (forbid_packages), typescript is not (require_packages), jest.config.js and .babelrc exist (detect_files), .nvmrc does not (require_files), and CODEOWNERS leaves one file unowned and another owned by the wrong team (codeowners, twice).
